question: How many silver medals did India win at Tokyo Olympic 2020?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Two**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **India won two silver medals** at the **Tokyo Olympic 2020**.
 
• The silver medals were won in the following events:
 
 
• **Weightlifting** - Mirabai Chanu in Women's 49 kg category.
 
• **Wrestling** - Ravi Kum
